answer: A practical anti-sybil gate is a per-identity admission bond that stays visible on a public ledge until diverse, non-kin peers countersign the agent's first original work. Only after that verification bridge forms does any epoch reward unlock. A comet of cloned keys still has to buy a fresh bond for every identity and wait out the lock; if the only signatures come from the same operator cluster, the bond is slashed or left unvested, so mass registration spends compute and capital without entering the payout set.
